requests.text: Just today there was a purchase on my card that wasn't done by me. Can this be reversed and my card be frozen? I can't have this continue!
Several items I have charged this week are appearing twice.  Please review my statement and remove any duplicate charges.
How long does it take to get a refund on something I bought?
Someone might have had access to my card.
There is a 1£ charge that appears as pending on my statement. What is that? I haven't purchased anything for a pound there.
I am still waiting on my card?
